name: object-detail-card
title: W4 对象详情卡 (ObjectDetailCard)
description: 对象详情卡（W4 · 尺寸 W）— 图标 · 标题 · 属性键值

files.content:
import * as React from 'react' import { Cube } from '@phosphor-icons/react' import { IconTile } from '@/components/ui/icon-tile' import { StatusPill } from '@/components/ui/status-pill' import { Tile } from '@/components/ui/tile' import { TILE_THEMES, type Hue, type Status, type TileTone } from '@/lib/tokens' export interface ObjectDetailCardProps { name: string subtitle: string status: Status statusLabel?: string icon?: React.ReactNode iconHue?: Hue fields: { label: string; value: string }[] tone?: TileTone } export function ObjectDetailCard({ name, subtitle, status, statusLabel, icon, iconHue = 'aqua', fields, tone = 'white', }: ObjectDetailCardProps) { const theme = TILE_THEMES[tone] return (
{icon ?? } {name} {subtitle} {statusLabel}
{fields.map((f, i) => ( {f.label} {f.value} ))}
) }
